title.zh-CN: 先天眼病与运动发育落后 · 11月龄男婴
title.en: Congenital eye disease and motor delay · boy aged eleven months

summary.zh-CN: 眼部病史、低张力和肾小管异常提示跨系统遗传病，不能只按单纯运动落后解释。
summary.en: Eye history, hypotonia and tubular abnormalities suggest a multisystem genetic disorder beyond isolated motor delay.

provenance.citation: 江芳, 高岩, 欧志英. Lowe综合征OCRL1基因突变一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2012;50(09):708-709. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2012.09.016.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

notes.zh-CN: 人工智能辅助初稿；尚未经独立编辑或执业医师审核。当前指南及来源DOI核验状态见导师指南。
notes.en: AI-assisted draft; not independently editorially or clinician reviewed. See the facilitator guide for current-guidance and source-DOI verification status.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别眼脑肾跨系统组合。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise the ocular, cerebral and renal combination.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用氨基酸及低分子蛋白尿定位小管。
learningOutcomes.en: Use aminoaciduria and low-molecular-weight protein to localise tubular disease.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明母血阴性与家系风险的边界。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain limits of negative maternal blood testing for family risk.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 协调酸中毒和多器官支持，诚实沟通遗传及发育预后
learningOutcomes.en: Coordinate acidosis/multi-organ support and communicate genetic/developmental uncertainty

prompt.zh-CN: 怎样统一眼、神经与尿液表现？
prompt.en: How can ocular, neurological and urinary findings be unified?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 考虑眼脑肾综合征如Lowe，评估近端小管功能
text.en: Consider an oculocerebrorenal syndrome such as Lowe and proximal tubular dysfunction

feedback.zh-CN: 先天眼病与小管性尿异常比孤立运动落后解释更完整。
feedback.en: Congenital eye disease and tubular findings provide a fuller explanation than isolated motor delay.

text.zh-CN: 仅脑性运动落后即可解释氨基酸尿
text.en: Isolated cerebral motor delay explains aminoaciduria

feedback.zh-CN: 肾小管证据需要独立整合。

text.zh-CN: 低张力和无反射即确诊SMA
text.en: Hypotonia and absent reflexes prove SMA

feedback.zh-CN: 该组合并非特异且还有眼肾线索。
feedback.en: This combination is non-specific and ocular/renal clues remain.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: OCRL1变异和三系统表型支持Lowe，母血阴性不使再发风险绝对为零
text.en: OCRL1 plus the three-system phenotype supports Lowe; negative maternal blood does not make recurrence risk zero

feedback.zh-CN: 需遗传咨询解释嵌合等剩余不确定性。
feedback.en: Genetic counselling should explain residual uncertainty such as mosaicism.

text.zh-CN: 母亲检测阴性证明家庭绝无再发风险
text.en: Negative maternal testing proves no family recurrence risk

feedback.zh-CN: 检测组织和灵敏度存在边界。
feedback.en: Tested tissue and sensitivity have limits.

text.zh-CN: 蛋白尿自动等于肾小球性肾病综合征
text.en: Proteinuria automatically means glomerular nephrotic syndrome

feedback.zh-CN: 氨基酸尿和低分子蛋白提示小管功能异常。
feedback.en: Aminoaciduria and low-molecular-weight protein suggest tubular dysfunction.

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 肾脏、眼科、发育康复及遗传团队协调酸碱营养、视觉听觉和家庭支持
text.en: Renal, eye, developmental and genetic teams should coordinate acid-base/nutritional care, vision/hearing and family support

feedback.zh-CN: 不以遗传诊断替代实际功能照护。
feedback.en: Genetic diagnosis does not replace functional care.

text.zh-CN: 基因确诊后无需重复肾功能和眼压评估
text.en: Genetic confirmation removes renal/ocular follow-up needs

feedback.zh-CN: 器官问题需要长期监测。

text.zh-CN: 可以保证完成正常发育里程碑

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告没有长期转归可支持保证。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：识别眼脑肾跨系统组合。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：长期肾、视听及发育结局、母体嵌合和原尿比重核实。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Recognise the ocular, cerebral and renal combination. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Long-term renal, sensory and developmental outcomes, maternal mosaicism and source specific-gravity verification. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 先天白内障青光眼、低张力发育落后和近端小管异常结合OCRL1支持Lowe综合征。
conclusion.en: Congenital cataracts/glaucoma, hypotonia/delay, proximal tubular findings and OCRL1 support Lowe syndrome.

keyReasoning.en: Recognise the ocular, cerebral and renal combination.

testUtterances.text: 现在能稳稳抬头或自己坐吗？
Can he hold his head steady or sit independently?
孩子目前能完成哪些动作？
What movements can the baby currently manage?
八个月时会翻身了吗？
Could he roll at eight months?
以前的大运动发育什么时候开始落后？
When did earlier motor milestones start to lag?
什么时候发现眼睛不追东西？
When was the failure to track objects noticed?
眼科诊断过什么病，做过手术吗？
What eye conditions were diagnosed, and was surgery done?
出生时有没有窒息或抢救？
Was there asphyxia or resuscitation at birth?
多少周出生，分娩顺利吗？
At what gestation was he born, and was delivery uncomplicated?
家里有人有类似疾病或遗传病吗？
Does anyone in the family have similar or inherited illness?
父母和兄弟姐妹健康情况怎样？
How is the health of parents and siblings?
平时怎么喂养，吃得怎样？
How is the baby fed, and how well?
喂奶情况有详细记录吗？
Is feeding described in detail?
对哪些药物过敏？
Which medicines have caused allergy?
用药后出现过什么过敏反应？
What allergic reactions have occurred after medicines?
以前有没有喂养资料方面的情况？
Could you describe any feeding information?
以前有没有过敏记录方面的情况？
Could you describe any allergy record?
以前有没有既往手术方面的情况？
Could you describe any earlier operations?
以前有没有日常用药清单方面的情况？
Could you describe any regular medicines?
